Results.ReviewText:
The grates are solid but heavy. Pre-heating the grill is a must!  The grill does what it says it will do if you follow the instructions!
Fits very well in our small camper!
Results.Title: My new Webber Q

Results.ReviewText: I debated on giving the grill 4 or 5 stars.  The reason is the weight of the grill.  I love the fact that it is heavy because I feel that it will last longer.  But it makes it hard to carry which makes it harder to take on trips.  I love the fold out "tables" and how quickly it lights and cooks.  If I had room I would buy the largest of the Q series and keep it outside.  But honestly for just me and my husband and maybe a couple of friends the 1200 is just the right size for us.
Results.Title: Good grill for 2-4 people.

Results.ReviewText: This is our 3rd Weber grill in 25 years ... each has survived many winter storms, almost daily use and has traveled to many campouts with us.
Results.Title: Perfect Little Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great sized grill for the picnic table. So far dependable starting and temperatures. We shall see how well it withstands the upcoming bbq season. I have higher hopes than other similar grills.
Results.Title: Great picnic bbq

Results.ReviewText: The perfect grill if you are rving.  It is easy to handle taking in and out of storage area.  The egg shape allows the meat to be cooked evenly.  Having multiple colors is a nice touch.
Results.Title: Red is our color.

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. We can understand your frustration with the grill not getting hot. Trying a 1lb tank is a great way to check if your regulator is working as it should. Our Support team will also reach out to follow up. Thank you!

Results.Title: Love the new tabletop!

Results.ReviewText: Grill appears to be high quality with more than enough BTUs for any job. Good size for most of my needs and easy to carry. It would be nice if the burner had an even lower flame setting though. I am building an elevated grate that sits about a half inch over the main grate for when I want a slower cook.
Results.Title: Very Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText: Had a problem with the regulator the grill wouldn't light after only 1 use and I called Weber and the sent me all the parts to fix it and now it works great!! Fantastic customer service and warranty!!
Results.Title: Service dept.

Results.ReviewText:
Just happy ~
It's hard to go wrong with a Weber (any grill), that's a given.  Probably happy with it before it arrived.  Having switched from coals/wood to gas, this small grill is easy and convenient and immediately likeable. The grill seems solid. Relatively easy to clean.  Like that it can be fueled with an LP tank.
Results.Title: Just Happy ~

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill two years ago and was unhappy with the lack of heat it produces (could not get more than 300 deg F).  I returned to the place I bought it and they exchanges the gas regulator.  This did not solve the problem.  After time I finally contacted Weber direct.  They sent me a new regulator and valve which solved the problem (it now can heat up to 600 deg F).  Sorry I took so long to contact Weber.  The service department was very helpful.  The grill is now fun to cook on.
Results.Title: Great compact and portable gas grill.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for the pontoon, geared up with Railblaza rail mounts on the accessory stand and works awesome.
Results.Title: Great Pontoon Grill

Results.ReviewText: Like my Weber Q 1200 however the regulator went out on it in less than a year. Reading online it appears this is a common problem. i will say Weber stepped up and sent me a new one at no cost. hopefully this one will last longer.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I've used the grill about 20 times...has lit so easy..retains its temperature(accurate gauge)  Very easy to clean...the grill itself is good for 2 or 3 people...the grill is cast iron and thus retains its heat
Results.Title: Perfect for 2

Results.ReviewText: I've owned this grill for over a year now. I use it for all my grilling needs. I'm a 1 person household. The Weber handles everything I need it to do. I can load it in the trunk of my car and take it where I please. I've brought to friend's house's before and done burgers for four people. One day I would love to get the Weber Spirit II E-310 to cook for a larger crowd but I don't have the space on my apartment patio. I currently having it running off of a full size propane tank. I highly recommend the Weber Q 1200 for cooking regularly for 1-2 people. I would move up to the Weber Q 2200 for regularly cooking for 3-4 people. You can check out YouTube to see people using the Weber Q 1200 and  2200 doing all sorts of cooking.
Results.Title: EXCELLENT GRILL

Results.ReviewText: My second small grill after many years using the original.  Easy to use.  Grills beautifully.  Love it.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText:
It’s a great grill. For a family of 4 or 5, superb.
Cooks wonderfully.
Results.Title: Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Very high quality product. Works very well, is sturdy, easy to clean, will last for years.
Results.Title: New Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for a small family and camping. This is the 3rd we have purchased. Replaced the grill we have used on the deck for about 7 years and we have one used only for camping. Easy to clean and perfect for us. We use it 3-4 times per week spring, summer and fall. We live in Minnesota and winter grilling is not for me!
Results.Title: Great grill for a small family.

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill! Have recommended it to everyone. This is the best portable grill I have ever owned.
Results.Title: Fantastic!
